findings.finding: Preregistration distinguishes prediction from postdiction by specifying research questions and analysis plans before outcomes are observed.

Leakage can enter during preprocessing, modeling, selection, and evaluation; preserving raw before scoring does not by itself prevent outcome or held-out information from influencing analytic choices.
Workflow-provenance systems record runtime/static configuration, software versions, arguments, and lineage because exact input and code hashes alone do not capture all reproducibility-relevant state.
sources: Huber et al., Scientific Data 7:300 (2020), DOI 10.1038/s41597-020-00638-4
